value.rationale: The source makes covariance geometry physically central. The result proves that two experimentally natural purity-probe classes erase precisely that geometry at short times: every localized slope depends only on incident marginal variances and the Haar mean only on total marginal variance. This is a substantive identifiability boundary that motivates sector/coherence observables rather than a routine numerical refinement.
